overview: Build a compact sci‑fi blaster/cannon: a chunky rear “power pack” body feeding a narrow barrel with a front muzzle block. Matches the reference silhouette (large block on left, thin barrel running to the right).

subassemblies.name: Rear Power Pack / Main Body
subassemblies.description: Large rectangular block (stacked bricks/plates) with a studded top, forming the heaviest mass of the model. Add a slight step/offset on the right side where the barrel attaches.
subassemblies.image_location: Left 40% of the image (big dark gray block with studded top).

subassemblies.name: Connector/Shoulder Block
subassemblies.description: Small 1–2 brick-wide spacer that bridges from the big body to the barrel, keeping the barrel centered and slightly lower than the top surface.
subassemblies.image_location: Just right of the main body (small dark gray block).

subassemblies.name: Barrel Core (Segmented)
subassemblies.description: A short run of alternating round elements (1x1 round bricks/round plates) to create a ribbed barrel look. Keep it straight and low-profile.
subassemblies.image_location: Middle-right (the line of small round pieces between the connector block and the muzzle).

subassemblies.name: Front Muzzle / Emitter
subassemblies.description: A compact front block using a stud-on-the-side (or bracket/headlight-style) element to suggest an emitter opening; optionally add a small top plate/tile as a sight nub.
subassemblies.image_location: Far right end (the blocky black piece with a circular detail facing outward).

subassemblies.name: Top Detail / Greebles (Optional)
subassemblies.description: A few 1x1/1x2 plates/tiles on top of the rear body to imply vents or control panels without changing the main shape.
subassemblies.image_location: On top of the left body block.

notes: Color-block for readability: Dark Bluish Gray/Light Bluish Gray for the body, Black for barrel/muzzle accents.
Keep the rear body roughly 4x4-ish footprint and ~2–3 bricks tall so the barrel looks appropriately thin.
Use common plates/bricks from the provided inventory for the body; use black round elements for the barrel ribs; use a SNOT-capable part for the front face detail.
This is a display prop scale build (not minifig-scale weapon) to stay sturdy with the available parts.
